notes: CBSA's credit agency 5 (CRDTAGY5, transaction OCR5): one of the five 'credit agencies' CRECUST (create customer) starts asynchronously with EXEC CICS RUN TRANSID(OCR5) CHANNEL(CIPCREDCHANN), after PUTting its 261-byte COMMAREA (the CRECUST copybook: the new customer) into containers CIPA-CIPE, then FETCHes the children and averages the scores. CRDTAGY5 DELAYs a random 1 to 2 seconds ((3 - 1) * FUNCTION RANDOM(EIBTASKN) + 1 into PIC S9(8) COMP), GETs CONTAINER(CIPE) of CHANNEL(CIPCREDCHANN) INTO WS-CONT-IN, sets WS-CONT-IN-CREDIT-SCORE to (999 - 1) * FUNCTION RANDOM + 1, PUTs it back and RETURNs; a GET or PUT failure is DISPLAYed and RETURNs; a DELAY failure fills ABNDINFO, LINKs ABNDPROC and ABENDs PLOP. No COMMAREA (its LINKAGE SECTION is empty: "commarea": null). The task starts with the channel its parent passed (oracle_assumptions.md X24); the containers on it are compared at the task's end, as CRECUST's FETCH CHILD sees them. FUNCTION RANDOM runs on the oracle's generator (C12) seeded by EIBTASKN, a stated fact of the run (X21): the scores are the oracle's, not z/OS's. A task takes no time: DELAY is NORMAL and EIBTIME does not move (X4). Not reached: the DELAY failure branch (A010's first IF, with POPULATE-TIME-DATE and the LINK to ABNDPROC): DELAY FOR SECONDS of 1 or 2 raises no condition IBM documents, and the harness injects none on DELAY; and the PUT CONTAINER failure branch (after a GET CONTAINER NORMAL on a channel in scope, nothing documented makes the PUT fail). Data: the containers are SYNTHETIC customers in the CRECUST layout. scenarios.why: the channel CRECUST builds: CIPCREDCHANN holding CIPA-CIPE, each the 261-byte new customer (CRECUST's COMMAREA, credit score 000). DELAY FOR SECONDS((3 - 1) * FUNCTION RANDOM(EIBTASKN) + 1) NORMAL (EIBTASKN 0: X21; the generator: C12; a task takes no time: X4), GET CONTAINER(CIPE) NORMAL, the score replaced by (999 - 1) * FUNCTION RANDOM + 1, PUT CONTAINER(CIPE) back; the other four containers unchanged

scenarios.name: no-channel
scenarios.why: started with no channel: GET CONTAINER CHANNEL(CIPCREDCHANN) names a channel not in the program's scope -- CHANNELERR (RESP 122, RESP2 2), RETURN; there is no channel to compare

scenarios.name: container-short

CIPE.text: CUST9876540000000042Mrs Fiona K Laidlaw                                         17 Abbey Road, Winch

scenarios.why: CIPE only 100 bytes: GET CONTAINER NORMAL, FLENGTH 100, WS-CONT-IN past byte 100 keeps its initial value (no VALUE clause: oracle_assumptions.md L3); the new score is set and PUT CONTAINER writes all 261 bytes back, so CIPE grows to 261
